## Summary

Describe what changed and why.

## Validation

- [ ] `dotnet build BNetSwitcher.csproj --configuration Release`
- [ ] Self-tests pass
- [ ] Relevant behavior was checked manually

## Release note

Use a Conventional Commit PR title. Examples:

- `feat: add tray account switching`
- `fix: repaint the window correctly while resizing`
- `docs: explain first-time account capture`

Use `!` for a breaking change, such as `feat!: change account storage format`.
